title: Shabbat Candle-Lighting and Zmanim Times input
description: Weekly Shabbat candle-lighting, havdalah, parasha and halachic times (zmanim) for any city or coordinates, computed offline (NOAA solar algorithm).

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: One per line: a built-in city name (e.g. "Jerusalem", "Tel Aviv", "New York"; see the README for the full list of ~65) or JSON coordinates {"latitude":41.85,"longitude":-87.65,"tzid":"America/Chicago"}.

startDate.title: Start date (a Friday)
startDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the first week's Friday. A date that is not a Friday rolls forward to the next one (never backward).

weeks.title: Number of weeks
weeks.description: How many consecutive weeks (Fridays) to generate per location.

include.title: What to include
include.description: "shabbat" = friday/candleLighting/havdalah/parasha; "zmanim" = the detailed halachic-times block; "holidays" = any holiday(s) on/around that Shabbat.

candleLightingMinutes.title: Candle-lighting minutes before sunset (override)
candleLightingMinutes.description: Leave unset to use the standard default: 18 minutes in the diaspora, 20 minutes elsewhere in Israel, 40 minutes in Jerusalem, 30 minutes in Haifa and Zikhron Ya'akov.

havdalahMinutes.title: Havdalah minutes after sunset (fixed, overrides havdalahDeg)
havdalahMinutes.description: Leave unset to use the degree-based time (havdalahDeg) instead. Common fixed values: 42, 50, 72.

havdalahDeg.title: Havdalah: degrees of solar depression
havdalahDeg.description: Used when havdalahMinutes is not set. Default 8.5 degrees (3 small/medium stars); 7.083 is a common alternative (3 medium stars, Rabbeinu Tam-adjacent opinions vary - see README).
